newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Treasuries end lower in sluggish trading.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Treasuries end lower in sluggish trading.

text.p: * U.S. Treasuries end slightly down in quiet mid-afternoon. * Volume very light. Bill sector particularly sluggish. * Scant retail participation seen. Money managers mostly out. * Dearth of economic data slows flows, eye on 2-yr note sale. * Some light year-end book squaring seen in long-end of curve.
